1: // OpenAI provider for anymodel
2: // Translates between Anthropic Messages API and OpenAI Chat Completions API
3: // Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, Azure, Together, Groq, vLLM, LMStudio, etc.)
4: 
5: // ── Request translation (Anthropic → OpenAI) ────────────
6: 
7: export const INTERNAL_EFFORT_FIELD = '__anymodel_effort';
8: 
9: export function normalizeReasoningEffort(effort) {
10:   if (typeof effort !== 'string') return null;
11:   const normalized = effort.toLowerCase();
12:   if (normalized === 'low' || normalized === 'medium' || normalized === 'high') return normalized;
13:   if (normalized === 'max') return 'high';
14:   return null;
15: }

17: export function shouldForwardReasoningEffort(model, {
18:   env = process.env,
19:   baseUrl = process.env.OPENAI_BASE_URL || 'https://api.openai.com/v1',
20: } = {}) {
21:   const mode = String(env.ANYMODEL_FORWARD_EFFORT || '').toLowerCase();
22:   if (['1', 'true', 'on', 'yes'].includes(mode)) return true;
23:   if (['0', 'false', 'off', 'no'].includes(mode)) return false;
24: 
25:   try {
26:     const host = new URL(baseUrl).hostname;
27:     if (!/(^|\.)api\.openai\.com$/i.test(host)) return false;
28:   } catch {
29:     return false;
30:   }
31: 
32:   const m = String(model || '').toLowerCase();
33:   return /(^|[/_-])(gpt-5|o[1-9])/.test(m) || m.includes('codex');
34: }

36: // P1.2: resolve an Anthropic image block to an OpenAI `image_url` data/URL string.
37: // base64 → data: URI; url source → the URL verbatim. Returns null for an
38: // unknown/undefined source so the caller can substitute a visible marker instead
39: // of silently dropping the image.
40: export function imageBlockToUrl(b) {
41:   const src = b?.source;
42:   if (!src || typeof src !== 'object') return null;
43:   if (src.type === 'base64' && src.data && src.media_type) {
44:     return `data:${src.media_type};base64,${src.data}`;
45:   }
46:   if (src.type === 'url' && src.url) return src.url;
47:   return null;
48: }
49: 
50: // US-003: a descriptive placeholder for an image we are NOT forwarding (non-vision
51: // backend or unresolvable source). Includes the decoded byte size + mime when known
52: // so a blind model still knows a screenshot was produced, instead of a bare marker
53: // or a silent ''.
54: export function imageMarker(b) {
55:   const src = b?.source;
56:   const mime = (src && typeof src === 'object') ? src.media_type : undefined;
57:   let bytes;
58:   if (src && src.type === 'base64' && typeof src.data === 'string') {
59:     bytes = Math.floor((src.data.length * 3) / 4); // base64 → approx decoded bytes
60:   } else if (src && src.type === 'url' && typeof src.url === 'string') {
61:     return mime ? `[image omitted: ${mime}, ${src.url}]` : `[image omitted: ${src.url}]`;
62:   }
63:   if (bytes != null && mime) return `[image omitted: ${bytes} bytes, ${mime}]`;
64:   if (mime) return `[image omitted: ${mime}]`;
65:   return '[image omitted]';
66: }

68: // US-003: decide whether the target model can consume image parts. `LOCAL_VISION`
69: // (on|off|auto, default auto) overrides; auto matches known multimodal model-name
70: // fragments. Coding models (qwen3-coder, deepseek-coder, …) are non-vision → images
71: // become a descriptive marker rather than an image_url the model silently ignores.
72: export function isVisionModel(model) {
73:   const mode = (process.env.LOCAL_VISION || 'auto').toLowerCase();
74:   if (mode === 'on') return true;
75:   if (mode === 'off') return false;
76:   const m = String(model || '').toLowerCase();
77:   return /(?:^|[-_/])(?:vl|vision|llava|pixtral|moondream|internvl)|minicpm-?v|gemma-?[34]|llama-?3\.2-vision|qwen[\w.-]*-vl/.test(m);
78: }

80: // US-004 (0013): detect an RLHF capability-disclaimer refusal ("I can't browse the
81: // internet", "I cannot deploy / run code", "I'm unable to access the URL"). A local
82: // coding model emits these as prose even with tools attached, dead-ending the loop.
83: const REFUSAL_RE = /\bI\b[^.!?\n]{0,30}?\b(?:can'?t|cannot|can ?not|unable to|am unable to|don'?t have (?:the )?(?:ability|access))\b[^.!?\n]{0,15}?\b(?:access|browse|visit|deploy|run|execute|open|reach|connect|provide|create)\b/i;
84: 
85: export function isCapabilityRefusal(text) {
86:   return typeof text === 'string' && text.length > 0 && REFUSAL_RE.test(text);
87: }
88: 
89: // US-004: should the proxy re-issue once with a "use your tools" nudge? Only when the
90: // retry is enabled, the response is a prose refusal ending the turn, AND tools were
91: // attached (so the model has a real alternative to disclaiming).
92: export function shouldRetryRefusal({ enabled = true, stopReason, hasTools, text } = {}) {
93:   return Boolean(enabled) && stopReason === 'end_turn' && Boolean(hasTools) && isCapabilityRefusal(text);
94: }

96: // P1.2: translate an Anthropic content-block array into OpenAI message content.
97: // Returns a plain STRING when every block is text (keeps text-only turns
98: // byte-identical to the old behavior for servers that reject array content), or
99: // an ARRAY of {type:'text'|'image_url'} parts when any image is present. Images
100: // that can't be resolved and documents become a visible marker — never a silent
101: // drop.
102: export function blocksToOpenAIContent(blocks, { visionCapable = true } = {}) {
103:   const parts = [];
104:   let hasImage = false;
105:   for (const b of blocks) {
106:     if (typeof b === 'string') { parts.push({ type: 'text', text: b }); continue; }
107:     if (!b || typeof b !== 'object') continue;
108:     if (b.type === 'text') { parts.push({ type: 'text', text: b.text || '' }); continue; }
109:     if (b.type === 'image') {
110:       const url = visionCapable ? imageBlockToUrl(b) : null;
111:       if (url) { parts.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } }); hasImage = true; }
112:       else parts.push({ type: 'text', text: imageMarker(b) });
113:       continue;
114:     }
115:     if (b.type === 'document') { parts.push({ type: 'text', text: '[document omitted]' }); continue; }
116:     if (typeof b.text === 'string') parts.push({ type: 'text', text: b.text });
117:   }
118:   if (!hasImage) return parts.map(p => (p.type === 'text' ? p.text : '')).join('');
119:   return parts;
120: }
121: 
122: // P1.2 + P1.3: extract the OpenAI `tool` message content from an Anthropic
123: // tool_result block. Returns { text, imageUrls } — images are hoisted out by the
124: // caller because the OpenAI tool role is text-only. When `is_error` is set the
125: // text is prefixed with a `[tool_error]` marker so a failed tool looks failed to
126: // the model (OpenAI's tool role has no structured error field).
127: export function extractToolResultParts(block, { visionCapable = true } = {}) {
128:   const imageUrls = [];
129:   let text;
130:   if (typeof block.content === 'string') {
131:     text = block.content;
132:   } else if (Array.isArray(block.content)) {
133:     const pieces = [];
134:     for (const b of block.content) {
135:       if (b?.type === 'text') pieces.push(b.text || '');
136:       else if (b?.type === 'image') {
137:         const url = visionCapable ? imageBlockToUrl(b) : null;
138:         if (url) imageUrls.push(url);
139:         else pieces.push(imageMarker(b));
140:       } else if (b?.type === 'document') pieces.push('[document omitted]');
141:       else if (typeof b?.text === 'string') pieces.push(b.text);
142:     }
143:     text = pieces.join('');
144:   } else {
145:     text = JSON.stringify(block.content);
146:   }
147:   if (block.is_error) text = '[tool_error] ' + text;
148:   return { text, imageUrls };
149: }

151: export function translateRequest(anthropicBody, { visionCapable = true, effortCapable = false } = {}) {
152:   const openaiBody = {
153:     model: anthropicBody.model,
154:     // P1.4: fall back to the newer `max_output_tokens` when `max_tokens` is absent.
155:     // sanitizeBody clamps each to >=16 independently but never bridges the two, so
156:     // a client sending only `max_output_tokens` would otherwise get `max_tokens:
157:     // undefined` and over-generate.
158:     max_tokens: anthropicBody.max_tokens ?? anthropicBody.max_output_tokens,
159:     stream: anthropicBody.stream || false,
160:     messages: [],
161:   };
162: 
163:   // System messages: Anthropic array → OpenAI system message
164:   if (anthropicBody.system) {
165:     const systemText = Array.isArray(anthropicBody.system)
166:       ? anthropicBody.system.map(b => typeof b === 'string' ? b : b.text || '').join('\n')
167:       : anthropicBody.system;
168:     openaiBody.messages.push({ role: 'system', content: systemText });
169:   }
170: 
171:   // Messages: Anthropic blocks → OpenAI format
172:   for (const msg of anthropicBody.messages || []) {
173:     if (msg.role === 'assistant' && Array.isArray(msg.content)) {
174:       // Handle tool_use blocks
175:       const textParts = msg.content.filter(b => b.type === 'text').map(b => b.text).join('');
176:       const toolCalls = msg.content.filter(b => b.type === 'tool_use').map(b => ({
177:         id: b.id,
178:         type: 'function',
179:         function: { name: b.name, arguments: JSON.stringify(b.input ?? {}) },
180:       }));
181:       const omsg = { role: 'assistant' };
182:       if (textParts) omsg.content = textParts;
183:       if (toolCalls.length) omsg.tool_calls = toolCalls;
184:       openaiBody.messages.push(omsg);
185:     } else if (msg.role === 'user' && Array.isArray(msg.content)) {
186:       // Handle tool_result blocks
187:       const hasToolResults = msg.content.some(b => b.type === 'tool_result');
188:       if (hasToolResults) {
189:         for (const block of msg.content) {
190:           if (block.type === 'tool_result') {
191:             // P1.3: preserve is_error marker; P1.2: hoist images (tool role is text-only)
192:             const { text, imageUrls } = extractToolResultParts(block, { visionCapable });
193:             openaiBody.messages.push({
194:               role: 'tool',
195:               tool_call_id: block.tool_use_id,
196:               content: text,
197:             });
198:             if (imageUrls.length) {
199:               openaiBody.messages.push({
200:                 role: 'user',
201:                 content: imageUrls.map(url => ({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } })),
202:               });
203:             }
204:           } else if (block.type === 'text') {
205:             openaiBody.messages.push({ role: 'user', content: block.text });
206:           } else if (block.type === 'image') {
207:             // P1.2: a bare image alongside tool_result blocks — emit as its own user turn
208:             const url = visionCapable ? imageBlockToUrl(block) : null;
209:             openaiBody.messages.push({
210:               role: 'user',
211:               content: url ? [{ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } }] : imageMarker(block),
212:             });
213:           }
214:         }
215:       } else {
216:         // Regular user message with content blocks (P1.2: images → vision parts)
217:         openaiBody.messages.push({ role: 'user', content: blocksToOpenAIContent(msg.content, { visionCapable }) });
218:       }
219:     } else {
220:       // Simple string content
221:       openaiBody.messages.push({
222:         role: msg.role,
223:         content: typeof msg.content === 'string' ? msg.content : JSON.stringify(msg.content),
224:       });
225:     }
226:   }
227: 
228:   // Tools: Anthropic → OpenAI function format
229:   if (anthropicBody.tools?.length) {
230:     openaiBody.tools = anthropicBody.tools.map(t => {
231:       const params = t.input_schema ? { ...t.input_schema } : { type: 'object', properties: {} };
232:       // Ensure type is set
233:       if (!params.type) params.type = 'object';
234:       // Fix empty properties: use the canonical "no-params object" JSON Schema.
235:       // Since 1.12.0 we use `additionalProperties: false` instead of injecting a
236:       // `_unused` placeholder — accepted by OpenAI, Groq, Together, vLLM, LMStudio,
237:       // Ollama, and preserves real tool params named `_unused` end-to-end (US-004).
238:       if (
239:         params.type === 'object' &&
240:         params.properties &&
241:         typeof params.properties === 'object' &&
242:         Object.keys(params.properties).length === 0
243:       ) {
244:         params.additionalProperties = false;
245:         if (!Array.isArray(params.required)) params.required = [];
246:       }
247:       return {
248:         type: 'function',
249:         function: {
250:           name: t.name,
251:           description: t.description || '',
252:           parameters: params,
253:         },
254:       };
255:     });
256:   }
257: 
258:   // Tool choice
259:   if (anthropicBody.tool_choice) {
260:     if (typeof anthropicBody.tool_choice === 'string') {
261:       openaiBody.tool_choice = anthropicBody.tool_choice === 'any' ? 'required' : anthropicBody.tool_choice;
262:     } else if (anthropicBody.tool_choice.type === 'tool') {
263:       openaiBody.tool_choice = { type: 'function', function: { name: anthropicBody.tool_choice.name } };
264:     } else {
265:       const t = anthropicBody.tool_choice.type || 'auto';
266:       openaiBody.tool_choice = t === 'any' ? 'required' : t;
267:     }
268:   }
269: 
270:   // Temperature
271:   if (anthropicBody.temperature !== undefined) openaiBody.temperature = anthropicBody.temperature;
272: 
273:   const effort = effortCapable ? normalizeReasoningEffort(anthropicBody[INTERNAL_EFFORT_FIELD]) : null;
274:   if (effort) openaiBody.reasoning_effort = effort;
275: 
276:   // P1.4: sampling parity. The real-world bite is `stop_sequences` — a local Qwen
277:   // loop relying on stop tokens over-generates without it. OpenRouter (native
278:   // passthrough) keeps all of these, so dropping them here was a parity regression.
279:   if (anthropicBody.top_p !== undefined) openaiBody.top_p = anthropicBody.top_p;
280:   if (Array.isArray(anthropicBody.stop_sequences) && anthropicBody.stop_sequences.length) {
281:     openaiBody.stop = anthropicBody.stop_sequences;
282:   }
283: 
284:   return openaiBody;
285: }

287: // ── Text-channel tool-call recovery (P0.2) ─────────────────────
288: // Local Qwen3-Coder under LM Studio (and other servers with a misconfigured or
289: // missing tool-call parser) frequently emit a tool call into the TEXT channel
290: // instead of the structured `tool_calls` array — as Hermes `<tool_call>{...}`,
291: // Qwen XML `<function=name><parameter=k>v</parameter></function>`, or a fenced
292: // ```json {name, arguments} block. Untreated, the proxy forwards it as plain
293: // text + `end_turn`, Claude Code executes nothing, and the agentic loop silently
294: // dead-ends. This recovers those into real `tool_use` blocks.
295: //
296: // Gated by ANYMODEL_PARSE_TEXT_TOOLCALLS:
297: //   'auto' (default) → on for local providers only (caller passes localProvider)
298: //   'on'             → always
299: //   'off'            → never
300: // Cloud providers (OpenRouter/OpenAI) are left untouched under 'auto'.
301: 
302: let __toolIdSeq = 0;
303: function genToolId() {
304:   // Deterministic-ish, collision-resistant within a process; avoids Date.now()
305:   // collisions for parallel calls in the same ms.
306:   return `toolu_txt_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${(__toolIdSeq++).toString(36)}`;
307: }
308: 
309: export function textChannelParsingEnabled(localProvider = false) {
310:   const mode = (process.env.ANYMODEL_PARSE_TEXT_TOOLCALLS || 'auto').toLowerCase();
311:   if (mode === 'on') return true;
312:   if (mode === 'off') return false;
313:   return !!localProvider; // 'auto'
314: }
315: 
316: // The fenced ```json pattern is ambiguous for coding agents (they print JSON
317: // examples), so it only recovers under explicit 'on' — never under 'auto'.
318: export function fencedRecoveryEnabled() {
319:   return (process.env.ANYMODEL_PARSE_TEXT_TOOLCALLS || 'auto').toLowerCase() === 'on';
320: }
321: 
322: // Parse the parenthesized args of a Qwen paren-style call, e.g.
323: // `url="https://x", count=3, dry=true` → { url:'https://x', count:3, dry:true }.
324: // Quote-aware: a comma inside a quoted value does NOT split the pair.
325: function parseParenArgs(argStr) {
326:   const input = {};
327:   if (typeof argStr !== 'string' || !argStr.trim()) return input;
328:   const pair = /([a-zA-Z_][\w.\-]*)\s*=\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"|'(?:[^'\\]|\\.)*'|[^,]+?)(?=\s*,|\s*$)/g;
329:   let m;
330:   while ((m = pair.exec(argStr)) !== null) {
331:     const key = m[1];
332:     const raw = m[2].trim();
333:     let val;
334:     if ((raw.startsWith('"') && raw.endsWith('"')) || (raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'"))) {
335:       val = raw.slice(1, -1).replace(/\\(["'\\])/g, '$1');
336:     } else {
337:       try { val = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { val = raw; }
338:     }
339:     input[key] = val;
340:   }
341:   return input;
342: }
343: 
344: // Parse a text blob for tool-call syntax. Returns { calls: [{name,input}], cleanedText }.
345: // Conservative: requires a strict whole-pattern match + valid structure so prose
346: // that merely *mentions* `<tool_call>` is not converted.
347: //
348: // `allowFenced` (default true) controls the fenced ```json pattern, which is the
349: // only AMBIGUOUS one for a coding agent — models legitimately print ```json blocks
350: // with {name, arguments}-shaped data. Recovery callers pass allowFenced:false under
351: // the default 'auto' mode (only the unambiguous Hermes/Qwen-XML spans recover),
352: // and true only under explicit ANYMODEL_PARSE_TEXT_TOOLCALLS=on.
353: export function extractTextToolCalls(text, { allowFenced = true } = {}) {
354:   const calls = [];
355:   let cleaned = text;
356:   if (typeof text !== 'string' || !text) return { calls, cleanedText: cleaned };
357: 
358:   // 1) Hermes: <tool_call>{ "name": "...", "arguments": {...} }</tool_call>
359:   const hermes = /<tool_call>\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*<\/tool_call>/g;
360:   cleaned = cleaned.replace(hermes, (match, inner) => {
361:     try {
362:       const obj = JSON.parse(inner);
363:       if (obj && typeof obj.name === 'string') {
364:         let args = obj.arguments ?? obj.parameters ?? {};
365:         if (typeof args === 'string') { try { args = JSON.parse(args); } catch { args = {}; } }
366:         calls.push({ name: obj.name, input: (args && typeof args === 'object') ? args : {} });
367:         return ''; // strip matched span
368:       }
369:     } catch { /* not valid JSON — leave the text in place */ }
370:     return match;
371:   });
372: 
373:   // 2) Qwen paren-style (qwen3-coder-next 80B hybrid):
374:   //    <function=name(key="v", ...)>  — optionally with a trailing </function> and
375:   //    optionally wrapped in <tool_call>...</tool_call> (the wrapper's close tag may be
376:   //    absent; the Hermes branch above leaves it because the body is not JSON). The
377:   //    canonical branch below would mis-capture `name(key="v")` as the tool NAME, so
378:   //    recover this form first and strip the whole span (wrapper included).
379:   const qwenParen = /(?:<tool_call>\s*)?<function=\s*([a-zA-Z_][\w.\-]*)\s*\(([\s\S]*?)\)\s*>(?:\s*<\/function>)?(?:\s*<\/tool_call>)?/g;
380:   cleaned = cleaned.replace(qwenParen, (_match, name, argStr) => {
381:     calls.push({ name, input: parseParenArgs(argStr) });
382:     return '';
383:   });
384: 
385:   // 3) Qwen XML: <function=name><parameter=key>value</parameter>...</function>
386:   //    Name excludes '(' so a paren-style call that slipped past branch 2 is never
387:   //    mis-captured here.
388:   const qwenFn = /<function=([^>\s(]+)\s*>([\s\S]*?)<\/function>/g;
389:   cleaned = cleaned.replace(qwenFn, (match, name, inner) => {
390:     const input = {};
391:     const paramRe = /<parameter=([^>\s]+)\s*>([\s\S]*?)<\/parameter>/g;
392:     let m, found = false;
393:     while ((m = paramRe.exec(inner)) !== null) {
394:       found = true;
395:       let val = m[2].trim();
396:       // best-effort: JSON-parse scalars/objects, else keep as string
397:       try { val = JSON.parse(val); } catch { /* keep string */ }
398:       input[m[1]] = val;
399:     }
400:     if (name) { calls.push({ name, input }); return ''; }
401:     return match;
402:     void found;
403:   });
404: 
405:   // 3) Fenced ```json { "name": "...", "arguments": {...} } ``` — only when the
406:   // fenced object is itself a tool-call shape (has a string `name`). Ambiguous for
407:   // coding agents, so callers disable it under 'auto' (allowFenced:false).
408:   if (allowFenced) {
409:     const fenced = /```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```/g;
410:     cleaned = cleaned.replace(fenced, (match, inner) => {
411:       try {
412:         const obj = JSON.parse(inner);
413:         if (obj && typeof obj.name === 'string' && ('arguments' in obj || 'parameters' in obj)) {
414:           let args = obj.arguments ?? obj.parameters ?? {};
415:           if (typeof args === 'string') { try { args = JSON.parse(args); } catch { args = {}; } }
416:           calls.push({ name: obj.name, input: (args && typeof args === 'object') ? args : {} });
417:           return '';
418:         }
419:       } catch { /* not a tool-call fenced block */ }
420:       return match;
421:     });
422:   }
423: 
424:   return { calls, cleanedText: cleaned.trim() };
425: }

427: // P1.5: single source of truth for OpenAI finish_reason → Anthropic stop_reason,
428: // applied at all non-streaming and streaming sites so they can never drift.
429: // `content_filter` → 'refusal' (Anthropic's moderation stop) rather than masking a
430: // blocked/aborted generation as a clean 'end_turn'. Legacy `function_call` is
431: // intentionally NOT mapped to 'tool_use': modern OpenAI-compatible servers all use
432: // the `tool_calls` shape, and the legacy function_call payload is never extracted
433: // here — emitting stop_reason:'tool_use' with no tool_use block would mislead the
434: // client. It therefore falls through to 'end_turn'.
435: export function mapFinishReason(fr) {
436:   return {
437:     tool_calls: 'tool_use',
438:     length: 'max_tokens',
439:     stop: 'end_turn',
440:     content_filter: 'refusal',
441:   }[fr] || 'end_turn';
442: }
443: 
444: // ── Response translation (OpenAI → Anthropic) for non-streaming ──
445: 
446: export function translateResponse(openaiResponse, { localProvider = false } = {}) {
447:   const choice = openaiResponse.choices?.[0];
448:   if (!choice) {
449:     return { type: 'error', error: { type: 'api_error', message: 'No choices in response' } };
450:   }
451: 
452:   const content = [];
453: 
454:   // Reasoning/thinking content (DeepSeek R1, Qwen3, etc.)
455:   const reasoning = choice.message?.reasoning_content ?? choice.message?.reasoning;
456:   if (reasoning) {
457:     content.push({ type: 'thinking', thinking: reasoning });
458:   }
459: 
460:   let textBlock = null;
461:   if (choice.message?.content) {
462:     textBlock = { type: 'text', text: choice.message.content };
463:     content.push(textBlock);
464:   }
465: 
466:   let hasStructuredToolCall = false;
467:   if (choice.message?.tool_calls) {
468:     for (const tc of choice.message.tool_calls) {
469:       const input = (() => {
470:         try { return JSON.parse(tc.function.arguments || '{}'); }
471:         catch {

534: export function recoverOpenAIToolCalls(openaiResponse, { localProvider = false } = {}) {
535:   const choice = openaiResponse?.choices?.[0];
536:   const msg = choice?.message;
537:   if (!msg) return openaiResponse;

539:   if (Array.isArray(msg.tool_calls) && msg.tool_calls.length > 0) return openaiResponse;

541:   if (!textChannelParsingEnabled(localProvider)) return openaiResponse;

546:   msg.tool_calls = calls.map(c => ({

560: function formatSSE(event, data) {

601:   let accumulatedStopReason = null;
602:   let accumulatedOutputTokens = 0;

619:   // US-1 (0009): emit the buffered text channel exactly once. When allowRecovery
620:   // (no structured tool_calls were produced), scan the buffered text for a parked

624:   function emitBufferedText(output, allowRecovery) {
625:     if (bufferConsumed) return;
626:     bufferConsumed = true;
627:     if (!bufferedText) return;
628:     let text = bufferedText;
629:     let calls = [];

631:       const r = extractTextToolCalls(bufferedText, { allowFenced: fencedRecoveryEnabled() });

640:         type: 'content_block_delta', index: bi, delta: { type: 'text_delta', text },
641:       }));

643:     for (const c of calls) {
644:       const bi = blockIndex++;

647:         content_block: { type: 'tool_use', id: genToolId(), name: c.name, input: {} },

650:         type: 'content_block_delta', index: bi,
651:         delta: { type: 'input_json_delta', partial_json: JSON.stringify(c.input || {}) },

657:   // P1.1: if the stream ended while a tool index was still awaiting its name,

662:       const bi = blockIndex++;

667:         index: bi,

681:   function emitStop(output) {

9: export function normalizeReasoningEffort(effort) {

11:   const normalized = effort.toLowerCase();
12:   if (['none', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max'].includes(normalized)) return normalized;
13:   return null;
14: }

16: function isNativeReasoningModel(model) {
17:   const m = String(model || '').toLowerCase();
18:   return /(^|[/_-])(gpt-[56]|o[1-9]\d*)(?=$|[-_./])/.test(m);
19: }

21: export function shouldForwardReasoningEffort(model, {
22:   env = process.env,
23:   baseUrl = process.env.OPENAI_BASE_URL || 'https://api.openai.com/v1',
24: } = {}) {
25:   const mode = String(env.ANYMODEL_FORWARD_EFFORT || '').toLowerCase();
26:   if (['1', 'true', 'on', 'yes'].includes(mode)) return true;
27:   if (['0', 'false', 'off', 'no'].includes(mode)) return false;

29:   try {
30:     const host = new URL(baseUrl).hostname;

32:   } catch {

36:   const m = String(model || '').toLowerCase();
37:   return isNativeReasoningModel(model) || m.includes('codex');

40: // P1.2: resolve an Anthropic image block to an OpenAI `image_url` data/URL string.
41: // base64 → data: URI; url source → the URL verbatim. Returns null for an
42: // unknown/undefined source so the caller can substitute a visible marker instead
43: // of silently dropping the image.
44: export function imageBlockToUrl(b) {
45:   const src = b?.source;
46:   if (!src || typeof src !== 'object') return null;
47:   if (src.type === 'base64' && src.data && src.media_type) {
48:     return `data:${src.media_type};base64,${src.data}`;
49:   }
50:   if (src.type === 'url' && src.url) return src.url;
51:   return null;
52: }

54: // US-003: a descriptive placeholder for an image we are NOT forwarding (non-vision
55: // backend or unresolvable source). Includes the decoded byte size + mime when known
56: // so a blind model still knows a screenshot was produced, instead of a bare marker
57: // or a silent ''.

59:   const src = b?.source;
60:   const mime = (src && typeof src === 'object') ? src.media_type : undefined;
61:   let bytes;
62:   if (src && src.type === 'base64' && typeof src.data === 'string') {
63:     bytes = Math.floor((src.data.length * 3) / 4); // base64 → approx decoded bytes

76: export function isVisionModel(model) {

116:       else parts.push({ type: 'text', text: imageMarker(b) });
117:       continue;
118:     }
119:     if (b.type === 'document') { parts.push({ type: 'text', text: '[document omitted]' }); continue; }
120:     if (typeof b.text === 'string') parts.push({ type: 'text', text: b.text });

Updated only `target.mjs`:
- Preserves all seven accepted reasoning effort levels, including `max`.
- Uses `max_completion_tokens` for GPT-5/GPT-6 and o-series models, including through gateways.
- Retains `max_tokens` for legacy/generic custom models and `max_output_tokens` as a fallback.
- Preserves explicit effort opt-outs, custom-endpoint opt-in requirements, exports, and image/tool translation.
